Negatives

I have had some issues navigating daily life without a smart phone. 2FA is possibly the biggest obstacle. Fortunately my phone has 2FA, but I require specific apps, like Microsoft 2fa, steam guard, or my school ID. Another big issue is the lack of banking apps. I find it extremely hard to keep a mental track of my spending when my check ins on the real balance are so few and far in between. The phone is also fairly pricey for what it comes with. My phone costed about $350.
